verdict.rationale: Ente Auth is a 2FA authenticator, so general-purpose automations are a stretch, but the evidence shows narrow automation: the official CLI can be used to back up Auth codes automatically, and the Homebrew formula describes it as export and decrypt tooling that can be scripted. The in-app 'automatic daily backups' only run when you open the app, so they are not truly background. Automation is limited to backup and export. Missing for 10: a general automation or workflow builder, documented scheduled or background execution, agent or AI-driven automation, and automation beyond backups.
